name: Danger!? Tsuchinoko?
text: You can reveal this card in your hand; your opponent randomly chooses 1 card from your entire hand, then you discard the chosen card. Then, if the discarded card was not "Danger!? Tsuchinoko?", Special Summon 1 "Danger!? Tsuchinoko?" from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card. If this card is discarded: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Danger!? Tsuchinoko?" once per turn.

name: Legendary Fiend
text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 700 ATK.

name: Meteor Rush - Monochroid
text: During the Battle Phase, if 5 or more attacks have been declared this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Meteor Rush - Monochroid" once per turn. If this card battles, it gains 1000 ATK for each attack declared this turn, during the Damage Step only.

name: Ars Magna the Division and the Union
text: You can banish this card from your hand; Special Summon 1 non-Spellcaster "Ars Magna" monster from your GY or banishment, also your "Power Patron" Link Monsters can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. If a Synchro or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can banish 1 "Ars Magna" card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Division and the Union" once per turn.

name: Alpha The Magnet Warrior
text: ''Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.''

name: Blasting Fuse
text: Activate only when all zones of this card's column are occupied. Destroy all cards in this column.

name: Dark Magic Curtain
text: Pay half your LP; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your Deck. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

name: Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Foe
text: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Dream Mirror" monster: This card can attack directly this turn. During the Main or Battle Phase, if "Dream Mirror of Joy" is in a Field Zone (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Friend" from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Foe" once per turn.

name: Ghostrick Mansion
text: Monsters cannot attack face-down Defense Position monsters, but can attack directly if all monsters their opponent controls are face-down Defense Position. All effect damage, and battle damage inflicted by monsters other than "Ghostrick" monsters, is halved.

name: Sari of the Silverwing Axe
text: (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card from your hand or field to it. It gains 100 ATK/DEF. You can only use this effect of "Sari of the Silverwing Axe" once per turn.

name: Submarineroid
text: This card can attack your opponent directly, but when it does so using this effect, the battle damage inflicted to your opponent is the original ATK of this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can change this card to Defense Position.

name: Wind Effigy
text: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a WIND Normal Monster.

name: Gravekeeper's Cannonholder
text: You can Tribute 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster, except "Gravekeeper's Cannonholder"; inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

name: Marincess Pascalus
text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Marincess" monster from your hand in Defense Position, except "Marincess Pascalus". During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Marincess" Spell/Trap in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Pascalus" once per turn.

name: Trickstar Bouquet
text: Target 1 "Trickstar" monster you control and 1 face-up monster on the field; return that "Trickstar" monster to the hand, and if you do, the other monster gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the returned monster, until the end of this turn. You can only activate 1 "Trickstar Bouquet" per turn.

name: Skull Flame
text: Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 "Burning Skull Head" from your hand. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect. You can add 1 "Burning Skull Head" from your Graveyard to your hand instead of conducting a normal draw in your Draw Phase.

name: Chow Chow Chan
text: When your opponent activates a Normal Trap Card in response to your monster's attack declaration targeting an opponent's monster: You can discard this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card (this is a Quick Effect).

name: Mokey Mokey Adrift
text: This card's name becomes "Mokey Mokey" and is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the GY. You can discard this card; add 1 "Mokey Mokey" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Mokey Mokey Adrift".

name: Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra
text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or GY) by Tributing 1 monster on either player's field with a Predator Counter. You can only Special Summon "Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra" once per turn this way. If this card is on the field or in your GY (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 other "Predaplant" monster from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 500 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Predaplant Drosophyllum Hydra" once per turn.

name: Naturia Exterio
text:
"Naturia Beast" + "Naturia Barkion"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. While this card is face-up on the field, you can negate the activation of a Spell/Trap Card, and destroy it, by removing from play 1 card from your Graveyard, then sending the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Adamancipator Friends
text: Excavate the top cards of your Deck equal to the number of Rock monsters you control +5, and if you do, you can add to your hand 1 excavated Rock monster with a Level equal to or lower than the number of the excavated cards, also place the remaining cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except Rock monsters.

name: Mudora the Sword Oracle
text: You can discard 1 other EARTH Fairy monster; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can place 1 "Gravekeeper's Trap" from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your field or GY, then target up to 3 cards in any GY(s), or up to 5 if "Exchange of the Spirit" is on your field or in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Mudora the Sword Oracle" once per turn.

name: T.G. Star Guardian
text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner "T.G." monsters
Once per Chain, during your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "T.G. Star Guardian" once per turn.
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 "T.G." monster in your GY; add it to your hand.
● During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "T.G." monster from your hand.

name: Frost Blast of the Monarchs
text: If you control a monster with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy it. You can banish this card and 1 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Set card on the field; destroy it.

name: Darklord Dance
text: Fusion Summon 1 DARK Fairy Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing monsters from your hand, field, and/or GY as material. The monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 1000 ATK. If Summoning a "Darklord" Fusion Monster this way, you can also use "Darklord" monsters your opponent controls as material. You can only activate 1 "Darklord Dance" per turn.

name: Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing
text: When this card you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Yang Zing" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing". You can only use this effect of "Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing" once per turn. Once per turn, during your opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster, using only "Yang Zing" monsters you control (this is a Quick Effect). Possession of a Synchro Monster on the field that used this card as a Synchro Material cannot switch.

name: RESCUE!
text:
(This card is always treated as a "Rescue-ACE" card.)
Target 1 "Rescue-ACE" monster in your GY, or if you control "Rescue-ACE Hydrant", you can target 1 monster in your opponent's GY instead; Special Summon it to your field. You can only activate 1 "RESCUE!" per turn.

name: Fiendsmith in Paradise
text: Target 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT Fiend monster you control; send all cards on the field to the GY that are not that monster. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; send 1 "Fiendsmith" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Fiendsmith in Paradise" once per turn.

name: Raijin the Breakbolt Star
text:
1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT Warrior monster + 1 EARTH Warrior monster
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card battles a monster without a Level, any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is doubled. During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed by battle or card effect and sent there this turn: You can target 2 Level 7 or lower Warrior monsters in your GY; Special Summon them. You can only use this effect of "Raijin the Breakbolt Star" once per turn.

name: Recycling Batteries
text: Target 2 Thunder-Type monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

name: Ojamandala
text: Pay 1000 Life Points. Special Summon 1 "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" from your Graveyard.

name: Counter Spell "Negate Attack"
text:
During the Battle Phase: Activate 1 of these effects;
● When an opponent's monster declares an attack while they control more monsters than you do: Negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect: Negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that monster.
When you draw for your normal draw in your Draw Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.

name: The Dark Dragon Lord of Ultum
text: ''A dragon from another star that awoke from within a sealed underground world. It's a well-known fact even in Dimension Zeta that when you first wake up, you can only exert one-thousandth of your true strength.''

name: Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel
text: Once per turn, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either effect, except Fusion Monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 card; add up to 2 "Cubic" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand.

name: Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord
text:
1 "Cubic" monster + "Vijam the Cubic Seed"
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards from your hand and/or field to the GY. Gains 800 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

name: Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord
text:
3 "Cubic" monsters
Gains 1000 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 3 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

name: Divine Anima Infinity the Creation Cubic Overlord
text:
4 "Cubic" monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 1500 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can shuffle all your banished "Cubic" cards into the Deck, and if you do, destroy 1 card your opponent controls. If this face-up card in its owner's control leaves the field by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon up to 3 "Vijam the Cubic Seed" from your GY.

name: Cubic Bodhi
text: When this card is activated: You can send 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to the GY. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; place 1 Cubic Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls (monsters with a Cubic Counter cannot attack, also negate their effects). If a "Cubic" monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only activate 1 "Cubic Bodhi" per turn.

name: Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils
text: If "Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye" or "Snake-Eyes Poplar" is in either GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn. You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela" from your GY; destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera" from your GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

name: Wicked Canon
text: Each time an opponent's monster declares an attack, place 1 Sinister Doctrine Counter on this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Wicked Canon" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 DARK Fiend monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 Fiend monster. You can send this card with 4 or more Sinister Doctrine Counters to the GY; Special Summon 1 Fiend monster from your Deck, then you can add 1 "Super Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Hope for the Future
text: If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster or "Elemental HERO Neos": Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions a "HERO" monster as material, using monsters from your hand, Deck, or field. If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Hope for the Future" once per turn.

name: Fireworks Celebration
text: Activate this card by placing 5 Celebration Counters on it. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, and/or a card(s) is sent from the Deck to the GY, by a Spell/Trap effect: Remove 1 Celebration Counter from this card, then, if there are no Celebration Counters on it, destroy it, and if you do, gain 4000 LP, then Set 1 "Celebration" Trap from your Deck or GY, then, if you have 1 or less cards in your Deck, you win the Duel.

name: Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~
text: You cannot activate the following effects of "Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~" in the same Chain. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; move that monster you control to another of your Main Monster Zones. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card and you control 3 or more "Elvennotes" monsters: You can negate that effect, then if you control a Synchro Monster, you can destroy that card. You can only use this effect of "Elvennotes ~Oracle Alicetea~" once per turn.

name: Mercurium the Living Quicksilver
text:
2+ Level 10 monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can attach 1 monster from your Deck to this card as material. You can only use this effect of "Mercurium the Living Quicksilver" once per turn. While this card has material, your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters in their GY with the same Attribute as a monster in your GY. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Detach 1 material from this card or take 3000 damage.

name: Elvennotes Regina
text: (Quick Effect): You can send 1 other "Elvennotes" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned to the center Main Monster Zone: You can Special Summon 1 "Elvennotes" monster from your Deck, except "Elvennotes Regina". If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Elvennotes Regina" once per turn.

name: Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
text: If 4 or more cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 2 Spells/Traps you control to the GY; draw that many cards, then you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-down Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn, all face-down cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. You can only use each effect of "Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse" once per turn.

name: Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God
text: You can discard 1 other card; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God", then if your opponent's LP are at least 2000 higher than yours, you can discard 1 random card from their hand. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God" once per turn.

name: Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God
text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God" once per turn.

name: Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God
text: If this card is in your hand and you control a "Sun God" card: You can Special Summon this card. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 other card in either GY; send 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, place the targeted card on the bottom of the Deck. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God" once per turn.

name: Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God
text: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God" once per turn. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY and you control a "Sun God" card, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return 1 other card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck, and if you do that, inflict 800 damage to your opponent. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand.

name: Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest
text: If you control a "Winter Raven" card, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" Spell/Trap or 1 "Sinful Spoils" card from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card or 1 Level 7 or 8 Monster Card in the Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it to your field.

name: Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven
text: You can send 1 other card from your hand or field to the GY; place this card face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon up to 2 "Winter Raven" monsters with different names from each other from your Deck, except "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven". When a monster declares an attack and this card is a Continuous Spell: You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

name: Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven
text: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Winter Raven" monster you control; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". You can only use each effect of "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

name: Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest
text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by placing 1 Level 1 FIRE Monster Card from your face-up field or GY on the bottom of the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the hand, then target 1 monster in the face-up field or either GY; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. You can only use this effect of "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn.

name: Salamangreat Markhor
text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY as material for a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE Cyberse monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Markhor" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except FIRE monsters.

name: Salamangreat Bastella
text: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Salamangreat" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can increase or decrease the Level of 1 monster on the field by 1. If you Link Summon a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; Set 1 "Salamangreat" Trap from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Bastella" once per turn.

name: Bunnillin: Mocha MOD
text: You can send 1 Normal Monster with 2000 or less ATK from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Bunnillin" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY face-up on your field. If your opponent Special Summons an Effect Monster(s), while this card is in the Monster Zone: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Bunnillin: Mocha MOD" once per turn.

name: Heretic Eradicator
text: When your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster, while this card is in your hand and your opponent has 4 or more monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set in their face-up field, GY, and/or banishment (Quick Effect): You can negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster, and if you do that, Special Summon this card (while you control no monsters, this effect and its activation cannot be negated). You can send this card from the field to the GY; halve the ATK of 1 monster on the field. You can only use each effect of "Heretic Eradicator" once per turn.

name: The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor
text: During your opponent's End Phase: You can place this card from your GY on top of the Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can return this card from the field to the hand, and if you do, each player draws 1 card, then your opponent can draw 1 card, and if they do, you must keep your hand revealed during this Main Phase. (Quick Effect): You can banish this revealed card from your hand; destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor" once per turn.

name: Reindsurm Amurusa
text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 non-WIND "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Amurusa" once per turn.

name: Reindsurm Luvian
text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 "Reindsurm" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Luvian" once per turn.

name: Reindsurm Carcasas
text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can send 2 "Reindsurm" cards from your Deck to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Carcasas" once per turn.

name: Reindsurm Gigalovendra
text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". (Quick Effect): You can send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, including this card; add 1 non-FIRE "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Ritual Summoned, or your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can shuffle up to 2 monsters on the field into the Deck. If this card and a WATER "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Gigalovendra" once per turn.

name: Reindsurm Giriakarma
text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". When your opponent activates a monster effect in the field or GY and you control this Ritual Summoned card (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, then you can shuffle 1 monster each from both your opponent's field and GY into the Deck, also if either of them was a Dragon monster, double this card's ATK. If this card and a LIGHT "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Giriakarma" once per turn.

name: Javelin Beetle of the Alliance
text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Javelin Beetle of the Alliance". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use this effect of "Javelin Beetle of the Alliance" once per Duel. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can target 1 other card in this card's column; destroy it, and if you do, this card gains 600 ATK.

name: The Winged Dragon of Ra, Sun God of Darkness
text:
"The Winged Dragon of Ra" + 3 "Sun God" monsters
Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard any number of "Sun God" cards, then choose that many of your opponent's occupied Main Monster Zones; your opponent must send the monsters in those zones to the GY. When an attack is declared involving this card: You can pay LP so that you only have 1 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid and the total ATK of all "Sun God" monsters currently in your GY.

name: Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God
text:
1 "Sun God" monster you control + 2 face-up monsters on the field
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) to your opponent's Main Monster Zone by sending the above cards from either field to the GY, but if you Special Summon this card with the second method, you can only Special Summon once for the rest of this turn. You can only Special Summon "Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

name: Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest
text:
1 Fusion or Synchro Monster + 1 Spellcaster or Illusion monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can place any number of monsters you control face-up in their owners' Spell & Trap Zones as Continuous Spells, then you can return cards on the field to the hand up to the number of Spells/Traps you control. You can only use this effect of "Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. Gains 700 ATK/DEF for each Spell/Trap on the field. This face-up Fusion Summoned card cannot be used as Fusion Material.

name: Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven
text:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck.
● Extra Deck: Add 1 "Winter Raven" card from your GY to your hand.
You can only use each effect of "Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

name: Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven
text:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Target 1 card on the field; shuffle it into the Deck.
● Extra Deck: Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

name: Lethargisaurus
text:
1 Defense Position Tuner + 1+ Defense Position non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned in Attack Position: Change it to Defense Position. This Defense Position card gains these effects.
● Change all face-up monsters on the field to Defense Position.
● Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to the activation of their own cards or effects.
● Once per turn, during the End Phase: Each player gains 500 LP for each Defense Position monster they control.

name: Karin the Celestial Sage of the Highest Heights
text:
2 Level 7 monsters
When your opponent activates a card or effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a monster(s) from the Deck (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; your opponent draws 1 card, then negate that activated effect, and if you do, destroy that card. During your Main Phase 2: You can target 1 Level 7 monster in your GY; take damage equal to its ATK, and if you do, return both it and this card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Karin the Celestial Sage of the Highest Heights" once per turn.

name: The Immortal Sun God
text: Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your GY or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions, then if you Special Summoned "The Winged Dragon of Ra" by this effect, you can send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your Extra Deck. During the End Phase, send the monsters Special Summoned by this effect to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can discard 1 "Sun God" card; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Immortal Sun God" once per turn.

name: The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness
text: Activate this card by sending 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 "Sun God" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is destroyed by battle: Its controller takes damage equal to its original ATK, then if you have "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your GY, you gain 1000 LP. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness" once per turn.

name: Reindsurm Conquest
text: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any number of Insect Ritual Monsters. You must also shuffle Insect and/or Dragon monsters from the GY(s) into the Deck whose total Levels equal or exceed the total Levels of the Ritual Monsters. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 Insect monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Conquest" once per turn.

name: Reindsurm Carnation
text: While you control a "Reindsurm" monster whose original Level is 8 or higher or your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, the activated effects of your "Reindsurm" monsters cannot be negated. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Reindsurm" monster or Dragon monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add 1 Insect monster from your Deck to your hand with the same original Level, but a different original name.

name: Reindsurm Butterfly
text: Send 2 monsters from your Deck to the GY, including an Insect monster, also you cannot Special Summon until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, except Insect monsters. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; all "Reindsurm" monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK/DEF. You can only use 1 "Reindsurm Butterfly" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

name: Reindsurm Practice
text: Add 2 "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then if your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, you can add 1 Insect monster from your GY to your hand. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; place 1 "Reindsurm" Field Spell from your Deck face-up on your field. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Practice" once per turn.

name: Deep Forest of the Winter Raven
text: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your Deck to your hand. "Winter Raven" Monster Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect of "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" per turn.

name: Salamangreat Gearblade
text: Special Summon 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your hand or GY, and if you do, equip this card to it. You can send 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your Deck to the GY; the equipped monster gains ATK equal to the sent monster's Level x 300. If this card is in your GY: You can shuffle 3 "Salamangreat" cards from your GY into the Deck, except Equip Spells, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Gearblade" once per turn.

name: Bunnillin Extract
text: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Extract" once per turn. If a card(s) is sent from your opponent's Deck to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand or Deck. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.

name: The Pyramid of Kepher
text: Send 1 Zombie Ritual Monster from your Deck to the GY; place 1 Field Spell from your Deck or GY face-up on your field, also you cannot activate non-Zombie monster effects for the rest of this turn after this card resolves. If your opponent controls an Effect Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Ritual Monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Pyramid of Kepher" once per turn.

name: Card Crawl
text:
You can banish (face-down) the top 5, 10, or 15 cards of your Deck, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; apply the appropriate effect to it.
● 5: Its ATK/DEF become 0.
● 10: Negate its effects.
● 15: Banish it (face-down).
You can only use this effect of "Card Crawl" once per turn.

name: Autumn
text: This card's name becomes "Summer" while in the Field Zone. Once per turn: You can place Season Counters on this card equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can take 1 Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY that you can place a Season Counter on, except "Autumn", and place it face-up on your field, and if you do, place all Season Counters on this card on that card. If a card(s) in the Field Zone would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

name: Sun God Domination
text:
If a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster is on the field: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Special Summon 1 monster from each GY to your field.
● If "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is on the field, take control of all monsters your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY and Tribute 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster; gain LP equal to the ATK it had on the field. You can only use each effect of "Sun God Domination" once per turn.

name: Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God
text:
Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 3000) with the following effects (this card is also still a Trap).
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster by this effect during your opponent's turn, you can Special Summon it.
● Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
You can only activate 1 "Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God" per turn.

name: Reindsurm Encounter
text: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Reindsurm" monster: Negate the activation, then you can add 1 "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand, and if you do, send 1 Insect monster you control to the GY. If a "Reindsurm" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can place this card from your GY on the bottom of the Deck instead. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Encounter" once per turn.

name: Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch
text:

● Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Diabell" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using up to 1 "Winter Raven" monster each from your hand, Extra Deck, and/or field.
● If you control a "Diabell" monster: Target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects until the end of this turn.
You can only use this effect of "Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch" once per turn.

name: Illusion of the Winter Raven Witch
text: Fusion Summon 1 Illusion Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your Extra Deck and/or field, also you cannot activate monster effects in the hand or GY for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Illusion monsters'. If the activation of this card in its owner's possession was negated by an opponent's card effect and sent to your GY: You can Set this card, and if you do, return all cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only activate 1 "llusion of the Winter Raven Witch" per turn.

name: Bunnillin Soft
text: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, Normal Monsters you control gain 1000 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Soft" once per turn. You can target 2 Normal Monsters in your GY with different Types, Attributes, and Levels; Special Summon them. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can add 1 card from your GY to your hand.

text: You can only play this card if you were present at the 2007 Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME World Championship. The ATK of all your "Elemental Hero" and "Neo-Spacian" monsters on the field is doubled.
